verdicts.explanation: The paper reports σNE = 9.0 · 10−3 S/cm for the PEO/LiTFSI r = 1/12 system from its own MD runs, which were run at a target temperature of 363 K, so the computational origin and temperature are right. The 90 °C conversion is a rounding of 363 K (≈89.85 °C) and is acceptable.

The paper reports σE = 8.8 · 10−4 S/cm for the same PEO/LiTFSI system, computed in this paper at the 363 K target temperature. The paper also notes that convergence is unclear even after 100 ns, which matches the record's notes.

The paper reports σcNE0 = 1.6 · 10−3 S/cm as its own computed result for the PEO/LiTFSI system at 363 K. cNE0 is introduced in this paper as an approximation to cNE, so the computational origin is correct.
The paper reports σcNE = 1.3 · 10−3 S/cm for the PEO/LiTFSI system, with an error of ±23.8%, from its own MD simulations at the 363 K target temperature. The record's values and origin are correct.
